Student Housing for internationals in Odense
Are you an international student? Find information on how to apply for guaranteed Student Housing in Odense.
All international students at the University of Southern Denmark are
guaranteed housing when moving to Odense if they do not live in Denmark when
applying for their study programme.
On this page, you can find all relevant information about this, including
information about housing options, the application process as well as
answers to frequently asked questions (FAQ).
Housing options in Odense
There are various housing options  in Odense in terms of price range, location, and facilities.
The options range from housing offered by private landlords, housing organizations and sublets.
Please note that the general state of the housing is reflected in the price. So, for housing options with a low rent, students must expect older housing that is not of the highest
possible standard .
That being said, all housing options are of an acceptable standard.
We cannot guarantee that you will only share kitchen and bathroom with students of the same gender.
All housing options are furnished with basic items such as bed, desk, chair and lighting.
You can find a list of all housing options below. Please note that the information is subject to error.
Damhusvej
One shared house with 16 private single-rooms.
The address is Damhusvej 18, 5000 Odense C.
The rooms are offered by a private landlord.
Facilities:
Internet
Kitchen items
Two shared kitchens
Five shared baths, 6 shared toilets
Shared laundry facilities
Shared backyard
Large common area
Price
Monthly rent including utilities and internet ranges between aprox. 3,260 – 3,700 DKK
One time deposit ranges between aprox. 9,780-11,100 DKK.
HousingOdense
About 116 rooms at different locations all over Odense.
Number of shared kitchens and bathrooms will depend on the location in question.
The monthly rent including utilities varies between aprox. 2,350-4,000 DKK
One time deposit ranges between aprox. 7,050-12,000 DKK.
Nørregade
One shared apartment with three single-rooms.
The address Nørregade 67, 3rd floor, 5000 Odense C.
The rooms are offered by a private landlord.
Facilities:
Internet
Kitchen items
1 shared kitchen, including dining area
1 shared bath
Laundry facilities shared with the rest of the apartments in the building
Price
Monthly rent including utilities and internet ranges between aprox. 3,500-3,800 DKK.
One time deposit ranges between aprox. 7,000-7,600 DKK.
Nyborgvej
One shared apartment with four 4 private single-rooms.
The address Nyborgvej 54, 2nd floor, 5000 Odense C.
The rooms are offered by a private landlord.
Facilities:
Internet
Kitchen items
1 shared kitchen
1 shared bath
Common area including dining area
Laundry facilities shared with the rest of the apartments in the building
Price
Monthly rent including utilities and internet ranges between aprox. -3,000-3,250 DKK.
One time deposit ranges between aprox. 9,000-9,750 DKK.
Ørstedsgade
One shared apartment with 12 private single-rooms t.
The address Ørstedsgade 28C, 1st floor, 5000 Odense C.
The rooms are offered by a private landlord.
Note that the rooms have sloping ceilings.
Facilities:
Internet
Kitchen items
1 shared kitchen, including dining area
2 shared bath/toilets
Shared laundry facilities in the kitchen
Price
Monthly rent including utilities and internet ranges between aprox. 3,200-3,450 DKK.
One time deposit ranges between aprox. 9,600-10,350 DKK.
Østerbro 7
22 shared apartments in a building from 2016.
Each apartment can house three students. Each student will have a private single-room, and the three students will share a  bathroom and kitchen with dining area.
Address: Østerbro 7B and 7C, 5000 Odense C.
The apartments are offered by a private landlord.
Take a 3D-tour of an apartment
.
Facilities:
Internet
Kitchen items
Duvet, pillow, sheets, and covers included
Shared laundry facilities in the bathroom
Price
Monthly rent is aprox. 3,470 DKK.
Aprox. monthly utilties: internet 45 DKK, heat on account 95 DKK, electricity on account 150 DKK, water on account 150 DKK
One-time deposit of aprox. 10,410 DKK.
Rasmus Rask student residence
640 rooms in an international environment, situated in the western part of
Odense, 7 km from the University, 4 km from the centre of town.
The largest student residence in the city. A mixture of Danish and
international students at both bachelor’s and master’s levels. You share a
kitchen and bathroom with one other student – possibly of another sex. Every
room has internet access. Linen and kitchen items are not provided by the
landlord.
The monthly rent, including utilities, is approx. DKK 2,700.
One-time deposit of aprox. 8,100 DKK.
Reventlowsvej
11 private single-rooms in a shared house at Reventlowsvej 37, 5000 Odense C. Three kitchens and 3 baths shared among the 11 tenants.
4 private single-rooms in a shared house at Reventlowsvej 43, 5000 Odense C. One kitchen and one bathroom is shared among the four tenants.
The rooms are offered by a private landlord.

Sublet
Room or apartment subletted by a Danish SDU student going abroad for one semester.
The housing options will vary greatly in size and price, but all housing options will be furnished.
The lease will be limited to Janaury 31st for the fall semester and  June 30th for the spring semester.
This may be a good option for you, if you have specific needs in terms of privacy or an accompanying partner.
Toftevej
11 shared apartments.
10 of the apartments can house three students. Each student will have a private single-room, and the three students will share a  bathroom and kitchen with dining area. The last apartment can house six students, wjo will each have a private single-room and share one bathroom and one kitchen with dining area
Address: Toftevej 51-59, 5000 Odense C.
Facilities:
Internet
Kitchen items
Laundry facilities shared among all the apartments
Shared garden
Price
Monthly rent including utilities and internet of aprox. 3,300 DKK.
One time deposit of aprox. 9,900 DKK.
H. C. Ørstedskollegiet
Please note that we have a very limited number of rooms at H. C. Ørstedskollegiet. Therefore, if you request a room at this dormitory, please also request a second priority.
Located 4 km from the city center and 1 km from the University.
A mixture of Danish and international students at both master’s and
bachelor’s levels. You have your own bathroom and share a kitchen with 14
other students. Linen is not provided by the landlord. Kitchen items are provided by the landlord.
The monthly rent, including utilities, is approx. 2,250 DKK.
Dalum Landbrugsskole
Only available for the autumn semester. Located about 4 km from the centre
of town, and 3–4 km from the University. Dalum Landbrugsskole, Academy of
Agricultural Business, Denmark is an agricultural college. Linen is provided
by the landlord. No kitchen items are needed, as there is no kitchen. Three
daily meals are included in the price.
The prices are approx. DKK 4,500 per month, including board.
Campus House
Only available for full-degree students. Opened in 2015, Campus House is a 14-storey building just a 5-minute walk from the University. You will have your own room and share a common area and three kitchens with up to 24 Danish and international students. Linen and kitchen items are not provided by the landlord. The use of a bicycle is included in the rent, but you must pay a deposit of 500 DKK.
Rent, including utilities on account, for a single room is approx. 3,830 DKK per month.
One time deposit of aprox. 10,155 DKK.
Rent, including utilities on account, for a double room is approx. 6,290 DKK per month.
One time deposit of aprox. 16,930 DKK.
Rent, including utilities on account, for an ease-of-access room is approx. 4,740 DKK per month.
One time deposit of aprox. 12,860 DKK.
Østerbro 1
Primarily for full-degree students. Østerbro 1 is a large apartment block
with shared apartments and private studio apartments, right in the centre of Odense.
The building was finished in the summer of 2022, and it is located a few
minutes’ walk from the light rail and only 15 minutes by bicycle from SDU.
All apartments are fully furnished.
The shared apartments are primarily for students on a full degree at SDU.
You will have your own room and share a kitchen and bathroom with two other
students. You can see an example of a shared apartment
here
.
The rent, including all utilities, internet, etc., varies between DKK 3,750–4,150 DKK.
One time deposit of aprox. 11,250 – 12,450 DKK.
The studio apartments can house two people and are therefore intended for
students who are coming to Odense with a spouse or partner. The studio
apartments also house PhD students and other international SDU staff. You can see an example of a studio apartment
here
.
The rent, including all utilities, internet, etc., is approx. 6,350 DKK.
One time deposit of aprox. 17,050 DKK.
Application process in Odense
1. Apply for Student Housing
You should apply for housing as soon as you have submitted your application to SDU, even if you
are not sure of being offered a place. If you are not offered a place, your application for Student Housing will be cancelled automatically.
Bachelor and master’s students can apply for accommodation
3 days after
they have submitted the application for their study program.
Exchange and guest students can apply as soon as they have submitted the application for their study program.
To be guaranteed Student Housing you must apply before the deadline:
September admission: 1 May
February admission: 1 November
You apply for Student Housing by filling out an online application form at
sduhousing.sdu.dk
.
When you make an application, it is possible, but not required, to add specific requests for your accommodation. For instance, you can request to share accommodation with a fellow student or partner. But please note that we cannot guarantee that we can grant your request. In the FAQ further down this page, you can read more about what sort of requests you can add to your application and how.
2. You await an offer
You will not receive an offer of Student Housing until you have received
your official acceptance letter from SDU.
We
begin
sending out offers from 1 June for the autumn semester and from 1
November for the spring semester.  Please note that not everyone will receive an offer on June 1st, as it may take some weeks to send out offers to all students.
The offer will be sent by email from Odense Accommodation Office.
3. Accept the offer of Student Housing
In the email with the offer of Student Housing, you will find a link, which
you use to accept or decline the offer.
You have 6 days to accept the offer of housing. If you do not accept the
offer before the deadline, or if you decline the offer, the offer will be
cancelled and you cannot expect to receive another offer.
4. You receive a Welcome Letter
Within a few days of accepting the housing offer, you will receive an email
with a Welcome Letter. In this letter, you can find information about:
Your accommodation
Payment
Contract
Arrival
Termination notice
Moving out inspection
It is important that you read this letter carefully. If you miss a deadline
for signing the contract or paying the deposit, you risk losing your Student
Housing and we will not necessarily be able to offer you anything else.
5. Pay the deposit
You pay rent from the day your accommodation is available. It may be as
early as 1 August/1 January, but can also be as late as 1 September/1
February. You can arrive later if you prefer, but you still have to pay rent from the day your accommodation is available
You will usually be asked to pay the first month’s rent and deposit one
month before you arrive. This should be paid by international bank transfer.
You can find more information on when and how to pay the rent and deposit in
the Welcome Letter that is sent to you when you have accepted the offer of
accommodation.
FAQ
Can I request a specific Student Housing option?
Yes, you are welcome to put in a request if you know which of our housing
options you would prefer. However, we cannot guarantee you’ll be offered
your requested accommodation.
You can state your request in the ‘General comments’ section when you fill
out your application. Please add a 1
st
and 2
nd
priority.
Can I bring my spouse, child, or pet?
Pets:
Pets are not allowed in any of the Student Housing. This also applies for pets in cages or  terrarium.
Children:
The Accommodation Office only offers single or double rooms, so you will not be able to stay in the Student Housing with a child. If you need family housing, you can apply for generel Student Housing in Odense at
Studiebolig Odense
. Please note that the housing offered on this site will be unfurnished.
Spouse/partner:
The Accommodation Office mostly offers single rooms, where only one person is allowed to stay. However, there are a limited number of  housing options where you can live two people. The options are a studio apartment at Østerbro 1 or a double room at Campus House. See housing options above.
We cannot guarantee that we can offer you Student Housing for two people, as there is a limited number of this housing option. Alternatively, we can offer you a single room.
Please see how to apply below:
If you want to live with your spouse/partner who will
not
be a student at SDU: When you send your housing application, you must state the name and email of your spouse/partner in the "Generel comments" section. Please also state that you will be bringing your spouse/partner, and that you prefer Student Housing for two people.
If you want to live with your spouse/partner who will also be a student at SDU: When you send your housing application, both of you must state each others name under the "Generel comments" section. If only one of you does this, we will not be able to offer you housing together. Please also state that you are a couple,  and that you prefer Student Housing for two people
Can I request to live with a fellow student?
Yes, you can request to live at the same address as a fellow student/students , but in separate rooms.
H
owever, we cannot guarantee that we can offer you a room at the same address.
State your request in the "General comments" section when you fill out your application.
To increase the changes of getting an accommodation together , please:
Make sure to agree on a the budget including utilities
Make sure that you indicate all the fellow students you want to live with. If the request is not consistent or correlate  we cannot offer you a room together.
Make sure that you both / everyone request the same address.
What should I do as a returning student?
The guarantee for accommodation applies once only. If you decide to extend
your stay, you will either need to keep your accommodation or give it up and
find something new on your own.
If you leave Denmark for a period (e.g. sabbatical leave, internship or
exchange stay), we cannot guarantee new accommodation for you when you
return to Denmark.
We will, of course, try to help you as best we can.
If you are a returning student, please do not apply via the online
application portal. Instead, you should write an email to
bolig@sdu.dk
. Please state why you need accommodation, when you need it
and how much you can pay each month, including utilities.
If we find accommodation for you, please note that you cannot expect to get
a room before 15 February for the spring semester. Many students have exams
until the end of January and will not vacate the rooms before then. Due to
this overlap, we will probably not be able to offer you accommodation before
1 February.
Can I receive multiple offers?
No. You will only receive one offer, and the Accommodation Office will not be able to send you another offer.
Are the rooms furnished and equipped?
All rooms are furnished with a bed, a desk, shelves, a chair and a lamp.
In some cases, linen and kitchen items will be provided free of charge by
the landlord. If this is the case for your accommodation, it will say so in
the Welcome Letter sent to you after you have accepted the offer of
accommodation.
If linen and kitchen items are not provided by the landlord, the following
applies:
Exchange students: Linen and kitchen items are not provided by SDU, and
    you must bring or buy these yourself.
Full-degree students: SDU offers a linen bag and a kitchen box to all
    full-degree students. You do not have to apply or ask for this
    separately – the linen bag and kitchen box can be found in your
    accommodation when you arrive. The linen bag includes a bed pad, duvet,
    pillow, 2 sets of bedclothes, 2 towels and 2 bath towels, 2 wash cloths
    and a package of dish towels. The kitchen box includes plates, cups,
    glasses, cutlery, kitchen utensils, pots and pans.
How will I get my keys upon arrival?
You will receive information on how to get your key in the Welcome Letter.
What should I be aware of in relation to moving out?
The deadline for giving notice is carefully described in your tenancy agreement.
Notice must always be given in writing to the Accommodation Office using a special form. The termination notice of tenancy agreement will be in your welcome folder or sent as a link in the Welcome Letter.
All landlords require that you move out of the accommodation 14 days before your tenancy agreement expires for them to prepare the accommodation for the next tenant. If you have any doubts about how to give notice, please contact the Accommodation Office upon arrival, as a late termination notice may result in additional costs for you.
In connection with giving notice, you are required to make an agreement for
a moving out inspection. You can hand in your keys to the landlord's caretaker at the inspection.
The landlord’s caretaker will inspect the accommodation in your presence and
make a note of what needs to be done. If needed, the accommodation will be
painted, and floors will be sanded and lacquered.
The expense will be deducted from your deposit.
The inspection notes, both upon moving in and moving out, should be
available to you in English. If this is not the case, please contact the
Accommodation Office before signing anything.
